args.name: path
args.doc: A path on www.pcfactory.cl: /, /tiendas, /centro-de-ayuda/..., /categoria/..., /producto/<id>.

moves.say: {page: /path} at the start of the sentence that takes them there.
moves.doc: Open a page of the store (a full load).

args.name: target
args.doc: A heading, section or card title exactly as the page writes it.

args.name: path
args.doc: The page it is on, when it is not the one in front; it is opened first.

moves.say: {show: Heading} as you start talking about a part of the page.
moves.doc: Scroll to a heading, section or card on the page in front and ring it.

args.name: question
args.doc: The question as the page writes it.

moves.say: {faq: Question} as you answer one of the page's questions.
moves.doc: Open one question of the page's FAQ (Centro de ayuda, Cyber, Gamer) and ring its answer.

moves.say: {tab: specs} as you talk about the product's specifications; about, warranty, stock (by store), photos, zoom (the big photos), pickup (which stores have it for pickup) or price_note (what Transferencia means) likewise.
moves.doc: On the product page in front, open a tab (Sobre este producto, Especificaciones, Garantía), scroll to the stock by store (Disponibilidad), step through the gallery, open the big photos (zoom, the gallery's own lightbox), open "Disponibilidad de retiro en tienda" (pickup, only when a store has it) or the ⓘ beside Transferencia / Débito (price_note), and ring it.

args.name: category_path
args.doc: /categoria/... from the category list, or /busqueda-avanzada?search=... for a search.

args.name: filters
args.doc: Each "Facet: Option" exactly as the listing writes them ("Marcas: Lenovo", "RAM: 16GB", "Tiendas: Costanera Center"); several options of one facet as separate entries.

args.name: min_price
args.doc: Pesos, for Rango de precios.

args.name: max_price
args.doc: Pesos, for Rango de precios.

args.name: remove
args.doc: Filters to take off, each "Facet: Option" as it is on ("Marcas: Lenovo"): its chip's ⊗ under Filtros, in place.

args.name: clear
args.doc: True to take every filter off with the listing's own "Limpiar todos", in place.

args.name: page
args.doc: The listing's page to show, 1 for the first (a full load, by its own page links).

args.name: size
args.doc: How many products per page: 12, 24 or 32, with "Productos por página", in place.

moves.doc: Go to the listing at category_path (a full load, if it is not the one in front; a category, a search, or a /busqueda?productos=… list), take off the filters asked (its chips, or Limpiar todos), then apply each filter with the listing's own checkbox, one at a time, waiting for the grid; then the price range, the sort, the page size and the page. A filter already on stays on. Reports listing.shown and listing.filtered.

args.name: path
args.doc: /producto/<id> or /producto/<id>-<slug>.

moves.doc: Open the product at path (a full load), then the tab named. Reports product.shown, then product.checked from the store's live price and stock.

args.name: query
args.doc: Words to search the catalogue for, in Spanish: "notebook gamer rtx 4060".

args.name: category_id
args.doc: A category id from the category list.

moves.doc: Read the store's own catalogue search in the visitor's browser, without moving the page: up to eight products with their live prices and stock, and how many match. Reports products_found.

args.name: paths
args.doc: Up to six /producto/<id> paths.

moves.doc: Read the live price (transferencia, otros medios, referencia) and the online stock of these products in the visitor's browser. Moves nothing. Reports prices_read.

args.name: path
args.doc: /producto/<id>.

args.name: store
args.doc: A store's name as the store list writes it, or a comuna or city.

moves.doc: Read the product's stock in every store (and Internet) in the visitor's browser; on its page, scroll to Disponibilidad and ring the store asked about. Reports stock_read.

args.name: name
args.doc: A store's name as /tiendas writes it.

moves.say: {store: Name} as you talk about one of the stores.
moves.doc: On /tiendas (opened first if needed), find the store, scroll to it, ring it and open its map card (address and hours). Reports store_shown.

args.name: paths
args.doc: Two or three /producto/<id> paths of one category; those not on the page in front are opened to tick them.

args.name: open
args.doc: Press the comparator's own Comparar once it holds two or more (the default), which opens the comparison page.

moves.doc: Tick the store's own Comparar box on each product (the card's box on a listing, the Comparar button on a product page), so the comparator's bar comes up; then ring its Comparar, press it, and finish on /comparador (a full load), reading the table. Refuses a fourth product or one of another category with the comparator's own reason. Reports compare_shown for the bar and compare.shown for the comparison page.

args.name: row
args.doc: A row of the comparison table by its label as the table writes it ("RAM", "Procesador", "Pantalla"), or "diferencias" for Destacar diferencias, or "precio" for the prices.

moves.say: {compare: RAM} on the comparison page as you contrast one spec across the products; {compare: diferencias} as you say what changes between them.
moves.doc: On /comparador, scroll one spec row under the products' cards and ring it across them; with diferencias, switch on Destacar diferencias and ring the first row that differs; with precio, ring the prices.

args.name: path
args.doc: The /producto/<id> to take out of the comparator.

args.name: all
args.doc: True to empty the comparator with its own Limpiar selección.

moves.doc: Take one product out of the comparator (its ✕ on the comparison page or on the bar), or empty it with Limpiar selección. Reports compare_shown, and compare.shown on the comparison page.

args.name: category
args.doc: A top category as the Categorías menu writes it ("Computación", "Partes y Piezas / Componentes").

moves.say: {menu: Categoría} as you walk them through what the store sells, one top category per sentence.
moves.doc: Open the header's Categorías menu and show that category's panel (its sub-categories), ringed; left open until the next move.

args.name: code
args.doc: The coupon code as the site writes it (LEN50).

moves.doc: On the cart (/carro, opened first), type the code into Cupón de descuento and press Aplicar, once the visitor said yes. Reports cart.changed and the store's message.

From the cart (/carro, opened first) press Continuar, then Continuar como invitado (never a login or Crear nueva cuenta), and stop on Tipo de entrega, where the visitor chooses store pickup or delivery. Reports checkout.changed. Nothing past that step.

slices.doc: the product page in front: its name, three prices, stock and specifications

fields.name: regular_price
fields.doc: The struck reference price the discount is computed against.

fields.name: online_stock
fields.doc: Units for delivery, as the store writes them ("+100", "2").

fields.name: source
fields.doc: page: read from the HTML; api: the store's live read.

slices.doc: where they are in the checkout: the step and the delivery options it offers
the comparison page in front (/comparador): its products with their prices, and the specification rows side by side

fields.name: rows
fields.doc: Each row with a value, in the table's order; values left to right, "" where a product has none.

fields.name: differs
fields.doc: The labels of the rows whose values differ.

events.doc: A product page came up, read from the page.
The store's live read of the product in front: its prices and stock now.
The checkout step on load and after a change; the brain writes its own line.
The comparison page came up, or a product left it, or Destacar diferencias changed: the table read from the page.
